gate.why: A wrong auto-label sends an issue to the wrong queue (a bug lands with the roadmap owner instead of on-call, or a question waits for a fix that never comes), but a triager re-labels it in seconds, and the ground truth here is itself maintainer labels with visible noise. Auto-label only above the confidence where the fit split erred at most 1 in 10; everything below stays in the human triage queue unlabelled.
